_comment: The Studio assembly line. Each vertical is an agent: it owns one slice of a game, wields specific Phaser 4 systems + Studio SDK modules, writes specific files, and is held to a machine-checkable gate. The conductor runs them in dependency order, re-measuring after each.

story.title: Writers' Room
story.gate: distinctness: game-diff UNIQUENESS vs sibling games >= 60
story.brief: Invent the game identity for {{name}}: logline, hero, antagonist, a 3-5 world arc, and a casting table mapping each engine primitive (gap, mover, wall, lowgrav, hazard) to this game's fiction. Write STORY.md and fill GAME_META.json (name, tagline, hero, verb, worlds). Diverge the VERB and SKIN from siblings; share the methodology.

concept.title: Showrunner
concept.gate: one-line pitch + the single distinctive mechanic named
concept.brief: From STORY.md, pin the core loop and the ONE signature mechanic for {{name}}. Decide which Phaser system delivers it (arcade/matter/lights/particles/filters/tilemaps). Record it in GAME_META.capabilities and open DIARY.md.

art-theme.title: Art Director
art-theme.gate: visual cohesion (judge.mjs median-of-N) >= target; one palette, applied via ColorMatrix grade
art-theme.brief: Define {{name}}'s look: a cohesive palette + Materials colors + a camera ColorMatrix grade (Studio.Juice.grade) that sets the mood. Edit the Materials table / theme so every surface reads as one world. No AI art needed; procedural + grade.

characters.title: Character Lab
characters.gate: hero + enemy on-model & animated; gate stays green
characters.brief: Design the hero and enemy chassis for {{name}} as procedural baked textures (Studio.Textures.bake) with a distinct silhouette + glow. If GEMINI creds exist, generate model-sheet-conditioned sprite strips instead and chroma-key them.

level-design.title: Level Design
level-design.brief: Author {{name}}'s levels via the Studio Level DSL (levels.js). Respect the reachability envelope (jump ~3.5 tiles up / ~5 across at the template tune), the placement laws (timed hazards need grounded runways; segregate guards from pits), and an interest curve peaking ~84%. EVERY level must pass the 0-death autopilot gate.

gameplay.title: Feel Lab
gameplay.gate: controls.mjs pass + feel-ab delta > 0.15 @ >=80% agreement; gate green
gameplay.brief: Tune {{name}}'s game feel (gravity/jump/coyote/buffer/skid) and implement the signature VERB. Change ONE thing at a time; keep it inert-until-used so the deterministic gate stays stable; verify with paired A/B feel.

animation-fx.title: FX / Animation
animation-fx.brief: Add juice to {{name}} with Studio.Juice: squash/stretch, hit-stop, particle bursts on key events, ambient particles, camera shake/flash, and GPU filters (glow on the hero, vignette + grade on the camera). Juice must read in a still frame and never break the gate.

texturing.title: Texture / Materials
texturing.gate: visual score up; backgrounds/tiles cohesive with the palette
texturing.brief: Build {{name}}'s textures: per-biome tile recolors + a procedural backdrop (Gradient/Noise game objects or baked DynamicTextures) consistent with the Art Director's palette.

sound.title: Sound Stage
sound.gate: SFX present for all key events; music/loop present (procedural or Lyria if creds)
sound.brief: Give {{name}} sound: map Studio.Audio.sfx to jump/coin/hit/win and add a looping bed (procedural; Lyria MP3 if VERTEX creds exist). Keep a deterministic offline synth path for recorded video.

qa-gate.title: QA / Playtester
qa-gate.gate: the single gated report: determinism + 0-death + non-black readback (webgl & canvas)
qa-gate.brief: Run npm run eval for {{name}}. Report determinism, the 0-death gate per renderer, and readback. This is the report the conductor reads to pick the next vertical.

ship.title: Publishing
ship.gate: /health live + the deployed build renders headless
ship.brief: Ship {{name}}: railway up from the game dir, generate a domain, verify /health + /api/meta, screenshot the live build, and record the URL in GAME_META.url + DIARY.md.
